qualification: Unresolved; document binding is not engineering approval

known_team_design.scope: Representative team design; dimensions/counts do not qualify mass, capacity, fitment or failure physics

required_contents: Configuration-specific panel, joint, attachment and clearance drawings
Installed dry mass including attachments, mass distribution and buoyancy basis
Shell roundness, guide alignment and dimensional tolerances

requested_packages.delivery_owner: Roof/suspension engineer and representative test laboratory
required_contents: Suspension count, positions, sizes, lengths, pretension and complete connections
Materials, joints and stiffness under relevant environmental conditions
Separate allowable loads and actual failure model, asymmetry, load redistribution and test or validated analysis

requested_packages.delivery_owner: Seal supplier engineering and representative test laboratory
required_contents: Exact models, mountings, spring geometry, contact, friction and snagging geometry
Load-displacement and rupture evidence for actual materials and connections
Evidence for the child failure and resulting geometry; no liquid-travel-only threshold

requested_packages.delivery_owner: Roof and vent manufacturer applications engineer
required_contents: Separate fixed-roof openings from the two deck vacuum breakers; gas-path topology
Actual models, sizes, bidirectional pressure-flow curves, reference gas/temperature, cracking/closing pressure and dynamics
Screens, arresters, ducts and leakage paths; subdeck gas volume and thermal/pressure boundary conditions

requested_packages.delivery_owner: Roof drawing/BOM owner and emissions engineer
required_contents: Hatch fastening/gasket, actual radar/manual well, both vacuum breakers and six specified suspension penetrations
Secondary-seal attachment to roof rim or primary shoe; gap evidence before tight-fitting claims
Panel joint construction, total seam length, exposed well area net of obstructions, well height and shell condition

requested_packages.delivery_owner: Fuel supplier quality or accredited petroleum laboratory
required_contents: Batch/season identity and true vapour pressure versus temperature, absolute pressure basis and method
Density and vapour molecular mass versus conditions or composition with an independently checked property model
Uncertainty and valid phase/temperature range; keep a reference blend distinct from Saudi PG95

requested_packages.delivery_owner: Instrument supplier, calibration laboratory and inspection/reliability engineer
required_contents: Exact instruments, order codes, measurement locations and method for each output
Calibration/response data and uncertainty budget with reference tool, installation, repeatability and coverage factor
Equipment-specific acceptance tolerances; acoustic/visual detection and localisation evidence; vibration spectra for actual faults
Chosen remote/offline/entry method and conditions maintained throughout work
Applicable access, atmosphere and permit prerequisites with available evidence; missing gas readings are not safe readings
Recording resolution and abort conditions; no live-entry authorization inferred from a simulated catalog
Pump model, impeller and speed: head/flow, efficiency, operating envelope and NPSH test data
Valve characteristic, stroke dynamics, seat leakage and passive check behaviour
Motor/VFD ratings and calibrated current/speed/vibration response before adding withheld channels

requested_packages.delivery_owner: Team design owner and emissions engineer
required_contents: Representative coordinates/elevation and defined weather/scenario period
Ambient, stock and surface temperature, solar, absolute pressure, coating and insulation basis
Measured data or a documented thermal model and temporal resolution
